title: Millennium Falcon
description: The Millennium Falcon was a heavily modified Corellian freighter owned and operated by Han Solo and his Wookiee first mate, Chewbacca. The pair made a lot of special modifications to the ship, including hidden compartments under the floorboards, and allowing it to reach point-five past lightspeed. The beat-up aesthetics of the old YT-1300 freighter left a lot to be desired for many seeing it for the first time. However, despite its looks, the Falcon really was as fast as promised.
